exact_claims.statement: The manuscript-defined full evaluation kernels and deterministic patches yield a lexicographically nonincreasing rank vector under prime insertion; equal complete mixed-radix records imply identical kernels, patches and evaluated minors at every stage.

assessment: For B versus B union {q}, with the other blocks, S, anchor point and degree allowances fixed, the actual residue point sets are nested while parent patches agree. Full rational kernel inclusion and equal codimensions force equal spaces and hence equal deterministic patch lists. The first changed codimension decreases, and the mixed-radix suffix bound gives the claimed integer orientation and injectivity. Equality for arbitrary incomparable block choices is not established by this argument and is not the source comparison.
supported_scope: All actual r stages, including failed dimension drops and zero-dimensional parents, without early-stop zero padding.
Full rational degree-bounded evaluation kernels, not one selected vanishing polynomial or an abstract replacement.
Identical kernels, normalized patch equations, chosen minors and evaluated minor products when the complete records agree in an insertion/deletion comparison.
Mixed-radix range 0 <= R < product_i(M_i + 1), injectivity, and nonincreasing orientation under insertion.
Comparable inclusion chains with equal endpoint records.
unresolved_obligations: The deterministic covering-patch lemma is a separate geometric dependency, assessed in the patch-height unit; this unit alone does not prove its existence or height bounds.
Do not use equal complete records to identify arbitrary incomparable paths without an additional argument.

Initial point-set, total-component degree and dimension hypotheses have been matched to manuscript lines 20-24 and 37-68 by parent integration. Fixed degree scheduling is assessed in cumulative-products; the residue-cut theorem itself remains a separate, unreviewed obligation.
Native Host-invoked independent Reviewer assessment remains required.
